goal: Build the fundamental movement patterns (squat, carry, hang) with joint-friendly volume over 4 weeks. Designed for beginners or returning lifters; every session caps at RPE 8.
name: Longevity Foundations

blocks.notes: Week 1: start at the low end of the rep range.
Choose a weight you can carry with perfect posture.
Accumulate hang time; step down before grip fully fails.
Add one set vs Day 1. Same weight unless all sets felt RPE 6 or less.
Easy day: stop each set with 1-2 seconds in reserve.
